scope: All currently installed native Office floors and original host rooms/facade/lift in canonical walking; editor restoration; independent fresh Game FPS

restart.method: Windows process stop after fresh checkpoint and consistent SQLite backup; original multi-floor Office scene read model and shared Game/Office visual placement; Office/backend/microphone untouched

limits: Native proof covers the current saved Office floors 2 and 3, one ordinary ground-floor approach and original lifts. Arbitrary layouts and every host level are not exhaustively native-tested.
Current initial geometry contains exact source meshes and is about 13.4 MB; it is cached keyed geometry, not per-frame actor replication. Mesh compression/deduplication was not benchmarked.

The reference takeover delta includes live NPC motion; no canonical pose was staged. Native guest company/lease lists are empty; immediate real-save ownership records and earlier nonempty account/company tests provide separate evidence.

Geometry rebase reuse is tested on the source layer. Native UI may replace its editor runtime when automatically selecting another floor; inspect counters are not proof of uninterrupted buffer lifetime across that replacement.

FPS is a short stationary original Game native-GPU sample at 704x396 internal rendering, not Office walking, sustained 60 FPS, vehicle load or a paired performance comparison. Actual live lighting/weather differ from older samples.

Existing C920/audio-reference/autoplay warnings remain; no physical microphone capture or playback. Long routes/cold Game prediction, lighting/temporal/water/audio parity and first-person own shadows/reflections remain unfinished or unverified. Full integration goal is active.
